title: Basket Case
review: Like {Taxi Driver}, every set, costume, and strand of facial hair, seems cheap and seedy. The men are perverted and the women are desperate. A dark and grimy film, probably for budgetary reasons, but possibly intentional too. Everyone in it looks weird. I liked that one lady who does the mouse impression the most. Theres a fun monster design but you barely see it, because they couldn't make it move very easily. And that's not to the film's benefit like {Alien} or {Jaws}; there are awkward scenes where they have to point the camera elsewhere, even while it's the centre of attention. Watch if you like {American Werewolf in London} or {Brain Damage}.
